messages:
Lina (CSM): Heads-up team — Velox go-live is scheduled Thu 11:00am PST. Were doing the quota + autoscale gate tomorrow. Need to finalize autoscale curve, blackout windows, and post-run feedback capture.
Arjun (Ops): Got it. Current reserved commit: 12 GPUs. Requested uplift to 30 GPUs for burst in ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/QTK-8022. Awaiting infra approval for extra vslots.
Priya (Solutions Eng): Customer confirmed model variant: llama2-70b-q4f. Theyre worried about tail latency on multi-turn prompts. Ill run a focused prompt sweep and add golden outputs. Also prepping a trimmed prompt set for the 15m canary.
Sam (SRE): SRE acceptance criteria: p95 < 450ms on 6k token sessions during canary; no OOMs; GPU mem pressure < 90%. Autoscale policy proposal: scale out when queue_depth > 10 for 30s, scale in when gpu_util < 35% for 3m. Max nodes 28, min nodes 4.
Lina (CSM): Ops: can we add an emergency abort window at launch + rollback play? Customer legal insisted on a 30-min blackhole trigger.
Arjun (Ops): Yes. Abort = cut dedicated route, shift 100% to hosted, notify customer & billing. I'll add a runbook step and notify on-call. Ticket QTK-8022 updated with abort flow.
ci-bot: CI pipeline enqueued: velox/gate-autoscale-check #512 by Lina.
Priya (Solutions Eng): Load harness I'll run tomorrow morning:
``
rplay --pattern multi-turn --rps 750 --duration 45m --model llama2-70b-q4f --tokens 200-6k --measure p95,p99,gpu_mem,gpu_temp --blacklist s3://velox/blacklist/blocking-prompts.txt
```
Found 3 problematic prompts that cause quadratic context growth; flagged them in s3://velox/blacklist/problematic-2026-03-23.txt.
Sam (SRE): Suggestion: temporarily enable prefix caching for repeated short prompts during bakeoff to reduce KV misses. We can toggle via /api/v1/runtime/feature-flags. I'll prepare a toggle and test impact.
Lina (CSM): Also capture renewal health flags: Velox has renewal in 90 days, they're sensitive to latency regressions. If bakeoff shows p95 drift >10% vs baseline we should flag renewal risk to AM. I'll draft talking points.
Arjun (Ops): Billing note: burst approval pending. If denied, fallback plan: reduce concurrency target to 500rps and stretch session timeout to 75s. I'm documenting cost delta in the ticket.
Priya (Solutions Eng): KMS and compliance check: velox-kms-02 is onboarded and rotation policy set. Ill attach key fingerprint to the run summary.
Sam (SRE): Dashboards: created velox/gate-ops (live) with p50/p95/p99, queue_depth, gpu_util, model_swap_events. Pager rules: p99 > 1.2s for 5m or OOM events triggers page.
Lina (CSM): Post-run: Priya please own summary + survey. Include: 1) perf deltas, 2) failing prompts, 3) recommended autoscale curve, 4) customer sentiment (one-liner). We'll send to Velox and ops stakeholders within 2 hours of finish.
Priya (Solutions Eng): Will do. Also adding a tiny survey: 3 Qs on perceived latency, correctness, and readiness to proceed. Link will be shortlink: rbwd.co/velox-feedback.
ci-bot: Run started: velox/gate-autoscale-check #512 1:03:12 UTC.
Sam (SRE): I'm on watch for the run. If we see sustained queue > 25 or p95 > 700ms for 3m I'm ready to trigger abort.
Arjun (Ops): All prechecks green except burst approval. If it comes through by 08:00 tomorrow we proceed at target load.
Lina (CSM): Thanks team. Ill notify the customer about the canary window and share the short agenda. Post any blockers here. :white_check_mark:
